accueil.title: Free PDF, image and video tools, no upload required
accueil.metaDescription: Compress PDFs and convert HEIC, WebP or MOV to JPG, PNG or MP4 for free. Everything runs in your browser, so your files stay on your device.
accueil.h1: Free tools for your files, without uploading them
accueil.intro: Compress a PDF, convert an iPhone photo or a video: every tool runs directly in your browser. No sign-up, no watermark, and no file sent to a server.

pourquoi.texte: Your browser does the work. Your documents never travel through a server, which keeps them safe and saves upload time.
No account, no email address, no daily file limit. The site is funded by advertising.
Built for iPhone and Android: perfect for converting a HEIC photo or shrinking a PDF before sending it.
